title: Technical Questions on Miss messages, etc.

posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
I'm a poster today aren't I.
Though I'm a bit more curious of a mechanic or something that was in Everlong in how the creator did it, and how that's working.
When a skill lands, there are multiple messages besides "missing", I'm not really sure how he did that.  That would be kinda nice in a game i'm doing for a skill rather to display "resist" than "miss" and so and so.  Was that done with a .dll file, a dynplugin, or something going on in an .ini file?
I am kind of curious.

posts.author: Maliki79
posts.body:
If you are familiar with JS, I believe there are cases for weakness, resist, missed, etc in the "results" code.
Sorry for the vague response, I'm not at my PC.
But yeah, if you can find that, you can rewrite the code to say whatever you need and under a number of action conditions.
For example, I pulled evasion out from "Missed" and made a "Nicked" message.
(This is referring to MV/MZ)
